items: PMGKAY food subsidy delivery fully digitized via Digital Rupee (e₹) tokens in Chandigarh and Dadra & Nagar Haveli.
**First UTs:** Chandigarh and Dadra & Nagar Haveli launched CBDC (central bank digital sovereign currency)-based Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) for food subsidies under PMGKAY.
**Digital Token System:** Beneficiaries receive Digital Rupee (e₹) tokens for food grain purchases.
